card.name: Capital letter right after a number
card.fires_on: A single capital letter (M, G, W, P) that comes straight after a digit and starts a code or unit. It appears in mutation names, metabolite names like 6MNA, and units like Gb/s.

modes.label: Metabolite or mutation codes
modes.description: M directly after a digit in short names such as 6MNA or a protein change.

modes.label: Digit plus unit letter
modes.description: A letter after a number that begins a unit or name, such as molar or Gb/s.

modes.label: Numbered section starts
modes.description: A capital letter after a reference or section number that begins the next word.

card.plain: It fires on a capital letter stuck right after a number, as in 6MNA or 1 Molar.
